Native image4s incremental NIfTI implementation is now installed and verified on its own checkout, issue bd-01M21J17MKGV12VQKYR99XCR8F. Public openScalarWriter/withScalarWriter reuse the shared codec; spatial blocks can target separate maps or a frame-major bundle using bounded JVM/Node .nii positional writes. Explicit sform reference, Long offsets, exclusive create and scoped close/failure semantics are covered. Native suites: 54 JVM and 36 Scala.js/Node tests. Public 160 MB payload under -Xmx64m checks all 40 million values; independent Python byte checks agree. Evidence: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/image4s/docs/verification/nifti-incremental-output.md and .json.gz, bundle SHA256 37b574da0bc057cdb9cdd46fd2ffaf0f1fad178a66fae37b8a29c2dda140510f. All 114 recorded native compilation inputs and 14 installed paths match. No provider pins, commits or publication changed.

This adoption issue remains open. Next inspect the exact image4s candidate /private/tmp/image4s-incremental-1 against ScalaFIM's pinned 497bfd164ad514ff3d1944699550c78caa57e85d before changing dependencies. Native image4s base 3fb9fd6 has substantial geometry/axis API evolution: ScalaFIM NeuroSpace currently uses the older FrameMetadata.create convention arguments; current image4s keeps structural units/convention on Frame and presentation-only FrameMetadata. Do not infer units/template identity from an affine or mechanically update pins. Qualify a proper native geometry/axis adoption or supported provider compatibility path, preserving owner identity and all required consumers/platforms. Generic NIfTI encoding stays in image4s; ScalaFIM owns estimate bindings, units/readout/physical axes, scientific completeness, manifests and the durable selected-block sink/catalog. New output is .nii only and requires RAS; the existing complete-image gzip/pair path remains available. Local Java25/Node26 evidence does not prove hosted JDK17/21 or the complete repository matrix. No duplicate writer remains in ScalaFIM; its Nifti.scala still hashes to 2e3e5743ddb986a0d9be2ecc3e13a5dcab691e8a160e7e65393286c6a4b2db5e.
